state: Second framing of the corrected I17 token re-consult (package verdict new store:: stands; only the token shape is re-asked). Facts from service.ts (844 lines): K27's openSession yields SessionFacts with no token; sessionTokenForTest, marked test-only, is the single disclosure path; put/settleWrite/pending/get/delete/list/closeSession each authenticate with that sess- hex token. I13 faced the same structure in K22 (db::pin_connection yields tokenless db::connection_facts) and chose a verbatim pass-through: db::connection_token_for_test is a real owner-first op returning str. I14 and I16 wrappers (db::callback_entry, db::dispatched_work, db::cancel_grant) that bundle facts with tokens do so because their services emit tokens as part of the primary call — no readout composition exists there. The prior round's compose recommendation rested on state that blurred this distinction; this round corrects it. Decide from this record alone.

i17_session_token_shape_v2.instructions: With the I13 verbatim-expose precedent now explicit as the identical-structure case, which token acquisition shape should I17 adopt: fuse disclosure into open_session, or expose store::session_token_for_test as I13 exposed db::connection_token_for_test? Prefer structural consistency across the catalogue unless fusion buys something exposure cannot.

criteria.compose_token_in_adapter: Fuse disclosure into open_session: one call returns facts plus token, no token verb enters the catalogue. Smaller surface and no ForTest name in stable Can, but the only family that fuses a withheld token, against I13's pass-through for the same structure.
criteria.expose_token_op: Expose store::session_token_for_test as a dedicated owner-first str-returning verb, mirroring db::connection_token_for_test one-to-one. Every family then maps withheld-token services the same way; rows see both verbs and the adapter stays a strict per-method pass-through.
